title: Opportunities
noneText: As rank tracking, Search Console, audits and the other modules gather data, opportunities appear here.
howWorked: Opportunities are worked out by rules from what the modules gathered, at no cost, every time they are shown. Estimated gains rest on click-through-rate tables.
title_near_top: “{subject}” is at {position}: move it into the top 3
how_near_top: Enrich the content against a brief, link to it from related pages, strengthen the title.
how_dropped: Check that the page still answers, its content did not change, and what competitors added.
how_low_ctr: Position {position} should earn more clicks: rewrite the title and meta description for the search.
how_losing_page: See which queries fell; refresh the content and check for technical problems.
how_cannibal: Choose one page for it; merge, redirect or refocus the others.
how_audit_issue: A high-priority audit finding; see the pages and the fix in the Site Audit.
title_orphans: {count} orphan pages: in the sitemap, linked from nowhere
how_orphans: Link to them from menus or related content, or drop them from the sitemap if they are not needed.
how_weak_links: They get links from one page or none; add internal links from related pages.
how_deep_pages: Flatten categories and pagination; link key pages from higher levels.
title_vitals: Core Web Vitals fail on phones ({metrics})
how_vitals: Real-user data; see the fixes that save the most time in the page runs.
how_slow_page: Trim unused JavaScript, compress images, defer blocking resources.
title_ai_gap: AI names competitors for “{subject}”, not you
how_ai_gap: Named: {rivals}. Publish a page that answers the question clearly and can be cited.
how_low_content: Add the terms, headings and questions of the pages ranking for “{keyword}”.
title_local_weak: Weak on the map for “{subject}”: SoLV {solv}%
how_local_weak: Average place {arp}. Strengthen the profile's category, reviews and local page.
how_rival_growth: See the keywords and pages it gained in the competitor gap.
title_lost_links: {count} lost links can be won back
how_lost_links: Contact the site owners in the link prospects; redirect pages that moved.
